finding: The CAO-12 row of the core-artifact-ownership QA strategy says that mutation-testing files an unresolved mutant as a QA finding 'with the test-strategy agent as owner'. Commit 072cd152 renames the CAO-12 Rule to 'Test-strategy agent resolves a filed mutant that no test should kill, and the planning agent owns a filed mutant that needs a test'. The RL-12 Outline 'The gate-check step files a blocking QA finding for a mutant it cannot resolve' and the mutation-testing skill let the owner follow the cause (RL-G24). The test test_st_0358_file_qa_finding_names_path_and_owner already checks both owners. Change the Behavior cell to: the gate-check step files an unresolved mutant as a QA finding whose owner follows the cause, planning-agent for a missing test and test-strategy-agent when no test should kill it. Owner: test-strategy-agent.
why_this_severity: The row is implemented, and its test checks the owner that the Rule and the skill name, so nobody writes a new test from the stale cell (no to fails_purpose); a reader of the QA strategy learns a wrong owner and must read the Rule to correct it (raises_cost). No story or code outside the run encodes the cell.
